name: 49332 · Mecosta, MI
findings: ZIP 49332 (Mecosta) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49332 (Mecosta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49332 (Mecosta) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
